question: How much water can a single oyster filter in one day?
answer: A single oyster pulls sea water in to feed, keeping the particles and algae and letting cleaner water out. It can do this for 110 to 190 litres a day. Day after day that adds up, so oyster reefs work as natural biofilters for the whole ecosystem.
move: One small oyster cleans 110–190 litres of water every day.
